description: This file contains server-side logic for handling advanced report filtering in the vtiger CRM system. It includes functions for generating HTML for primary and secondary module columns, managing related fields, and processing request parameters to retrieve and prepare report filter data.

methods.name: getPrimaryColumns_AdvFilterHTML
methods.description: Generates HTML for primary module columns in the advanced filter UI, presenting options grouped by module-specific column sets.

methods.name: getSecondaryColumns_AdvFilterHTML
methods.description: Generates HTML for secondary module columns in the advanced filter UI, supporting multiple related modules and nested options.

methods.name: getRelatedColumns
methods.description: Returns option HTML elements for related fields, filtered by selection.

methods.name: getRelatedFieldColumns
methods.description: Provides access to the related fields array used elsewhere in the filter UI.
